announce1.announce-note: · Tuesday to Saturday, when a slot is open
consult.h1: Tell us what hurts. We will call you back.
consult.lead: Fill this in and the Clifton office calls you back to work out how urgent it is and when Dr. Gazu can see you. If you are in real pain right now, calling (973) 264-0928 is faster.
consult.microproof: Same day appointments · 3D imaging on site · Sedation available
consult.note-title: Call 911 or go to an ER
consult.note: for trouble breathing or swallowing, uncontrolled bleeding, or serious facial trauma. An emergency room can manage pain and infection, but only a dentist can treat the tooth itself.
consult.form-note: The office calls back Tuesday to Friday, 9am to 5pm, and Saturday, 8am to 4pm. A request is not a confirmed appointment until the team has spoken with you.
consult.reviews-h2: 4.8 out of 5, across more than 200 reviews.
section-mist12.text: Marvel Dental patients rate the practice 4.8 from over 200 public reviews, and Dr. Anna Gazu was named one of the top 10 dentists in Clifton for 2026 by BusinessRate. The films below are the practice's own patient stories.
consult.legal: Urgent visits are scheduled by clinical need and availability. A request is not a confirmed appointment until the office has spoken with you. An emergency exam is typically $75 to $200, and you receive an estimate before any treatment begins.
